definitions.short: a collection , i.e. community of persons
definitions.full: H523. ummah [ אֻמָּה ] noun feminine tribe, people (Arabic ; Assyrian ummatu compare Jen Kosmol. 336 , Aramaic , אוּמָּא ) only plural אֻמּוֺת Num 25:15 ; אֻמִּים Psa 117:1 ; suffix אֻמֹּתָם Gen 25:16 ; — of tribes of Ishmaelites 25:16 ; of Midian (|| בֵּיתאָֿב ) Num 25:15 ; || גּוֺיִם Psa 117:1 . אֻמָּה noun feminine nation (Biblical Hebrew id. , late); — absolute ׳א Dan 3:29 ; plural emphatic אֻמַּיָא 3:4 , 7 ; Daniel 3:31; 5:19 ; 6:26 ; 7:14 ; Ezra 4:10 .
